_comment_files: players_file/courses_file point at the roster and course data for THIS year. Course pars and stroke indexes come from courses.json only -- the PlayThru pages publish no par or handicap data, so courses.json is the sole source and was verified hole-by-hole against the paper scorecards.
_comment_sheet: ID of the 2026 Google Sheet this publishes to. This is NOT the 2025 sheet; that data must stay intact. If ever blanked, the pipeline writes local JSON only.
_comment_handicap_allocation: full = every stroke the handicap says (a 30 gets 30). capped = old notebook rule of max 1 stroke/hole. Use full. See SCORING.md.
_comment_rounds: One entry per round. scoring_style: best_ball_individual | match_play | team_scramble | two_man_scramble. scrape_url: PlayThru leaderboard URL (null for manual-entry rounds). The eids below are the REAL 2026 events, each verified to serve the right course, day and entry list.
